description:
`DocumentReference` carries six builder methods under `allow(dead_code)`. Production calls none of them, and tests construct references through them from 38 places.

## Background

The builders sit at `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:848-899`, each under `allow(dead_code)`. `with_format` and `with_assets` have no caller; the `with_format` hits at `output.rs:253` and `artifact_discovery.rs:460` belong to `artifact_plan.rs:683`. `new`, `at_commit`, `with_label` and `with_type` are called only from tests, at 38 sites:

- `commands/archive.rs` (14), `domain/types.rs` (10), `domain/projection.rs` (3), `repository_state/archive.rs` (2).
- One each in `commands/gate_check.rs`, `declarations/rules.rs`, `domain/artifact_conformance.rs`, `gate_execution.rs` and `validation/local.rs`.
- Integration tests `tests/fast_docs_templates/artifact_discovery_tests.rs`, `tests/fast_docs_templates/artifact_inventory_tests.rs` and `tests/fast_rules/example_rulesets_tests.rs` (2).

The web `DocumentReference` TypeScript type mirrors the struct shape and is unaffected.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `DocumentReference` has none of the six builder methods and no `allow(dead_code)`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Tests construct references through one shared fixture, and no test file defines its own reference-building helper.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each rewritten test asserts the property it asserted before.

## Notes

The shared fixture lives in `crates/jit/src/test_utils.rs`, a public module that both unit and integration tests reach.
title: Remove the DocumentReference builder methods
